issue_request: FHIR-35855 asked to harmonize ElementDefinition.isSummary guidance with the interpretation table/tooling by removing ", so servers might not support per-profile use of the isSummary flag" from the usage note. The issue was Published with a Persuasive resolution for R5.

additional_context: ElementDefinition is active current build content: source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition under [types] and maps elementdefinition to the ElementDefinition page. source/elementdefinition.html still marks isSummary in constraint definitions with the dagger note requiring the value to match the base definition, which is the profile behavior that motivated the issue. Later same-line work for FHIR-33148 expanded the isSummary guidance while preserving the FHIR-35855 removal. Older tools/history release snapshots still contain the old sentence, but they are historical artifacts rather than current build source.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current authoritative source retains "Note that servers may pre-cache summarized resources for optimal performance." and continues without the removed per-profile clause, so the current spec is already correct for FHIR-35855.
